endif()

    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/generated/jni/plugin_bindings.cpp")
if(NOT EXISTS "${_SUPERNOTE_PLUGIN_BINDINGS}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Supernote generated JSI bindings are missing")
endif()

    src/feature_registry.cpp
    src/runtime_bootstrap.cpp
    src/runtime_services.cpp
    "${_SUPERNOTE_PLUGIN_BINDINGS}"
)

# This dependency-free bridge is loaded from a unique path by each plugin
# ClassLoader. It contains no runtime services; it only enters the one
# process-loaded runtime component so that component can register JNI methods
# on the replacement ClassLoader.
add_library(sn_supernote_runtime_b1ee3d0df6ed_registration SHARED
    src/runtime_registration_bridge.c
)

find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
find_package(ReactAndroid REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(fbjni REQUIRED CONFIG)
set(_SUPERNOTE_COMPILE_TARGET sn_supernote_runtime_b1ee3d0df6ed_compile_contract)
add_library(${_SUPERNOTE_COMPILE_TARGET} INTERFACE)
target_compile_features(
    ${_SUPERNOTE_COMPILE_TARGET} INTERFACE c_std_23 cxx_std_23)
target_include_directories(${_SUPERNOTE_COMPILE_TARGET} INTERFACE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include")
target_link_libraries(${_SUPERNOTE_COMPILE_TARGET} INTERFACE
    Threads::Threads
    ReactAndroid::jsi
    ReactAndroid::reactnative
    fbjni::fbjni
    log)
target_compile_features(sn_supernote_runtime_b1ee3d0df6ed PRIVATE cxx_std_23)
set_target_properties(
    sn_supernote_runtime_b1ee3d0df6ed PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 23
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES
    C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
    CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
    VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN YES)
# JNI and JSI provide many inline C++ member functions as weak definitions.
# A reloadable plugin DSO must bind those definitions to itself; otherwise the
# Android linker may interpose a definition from an older plugin DSO and leave
# a stale function address behind when that DSO is unloaded.
target_link_options(sn_supernote_runtime_b1ee3d0df6ed PRIVATE "-Wl,-Bsymbolic-functions")
if(SUPERNOTE_MODULE_WEAK_OBJECT_PROBE)
  target_compile_definitions(
      sn_supernote_runtime_b1ee3d0df6ed PRIVATE SUPERNOTE_MODULE_WEAK_OBJECT_PROBE=1)
endif()
target_include_directories(
    sn_supernote_runtime_b1ee3d0df6ed PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include")
target_link_libraries(
    sn_supernote_runtime_b1ee3d0df6ed PRIVATE ${_SUPERNOTE_COMPILE_TARGET})

# Package CMake files own feature source selection and author dependency hooks.
# LINK_ONLY retains each static archive's link dependencies without leaking its
# PUBLIC compile usage requirements into the shared runtime or sibling features.
